23900.meaning1: time when measuring fields and land

23901.meaning1: headed by fields and land; under the heading of fields and land

23902.meaningLit: discourse on fields and plots of land

examples.text: yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… aṅgavijjā vatthuvijjā khettavijjā sivavijjā bhūtavijjā bhūrivijjā ahivijjā visavijjā vicchikavijjā mūsikavijjā sakuṇavijjā

23905.meaning2: to be likened to a field
23905.commentary: (ANa) khett'ūpame'ti viruhan'aṭṭhena khettasadise. (PVa) khett'ūpamā'ti khittaṃ vuttaṃ bījaṃ tāya'ti mahapphalabhāvakaraṇena rakkhatī'ti khettaṃ, sālibīj'ādīnaṃ viruhan'aṭṭhānaṃ. taṃ upamā etesan'ti khett'ūpamā, kedārasadisā'ti attho.

examples.text: cattañ'ca muttañ'ca anuggahītaṃ, khett'ūpame arahante viditvā, so duccajaṃ sappuriso cajitvā, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti.
khett'ūpamā arahanto, dāyakā kassak'ūpamā, bīj'ūpamaṃ deyyadhammaṃ, etto nibbattate phalaṃ.

23907.meaningLit: discourse on the simile of the field

23909.commentary: (ANa) ummādavasena araññaṃ pavisitvā viharanto pana ummādā cittakkhepā āraññako nāma hoti. (DHPa) cittakkhepan'ti ummādaṃ.

examples.text: vedanaṃ pharusaṃ jāniṃ, sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ, garukaṃ vā'pi ābādhaṃ, cittakkhepañ'ca pāpuṇe.
mandattā momūhattā aññaṃ byākaroti, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato aññaṃ byākaroti, ummādā cittakkhepā aññaṃ byākaroti, adhimānena aññaṃ byākaroti, samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaroti.

23914.meaning2: spends (time or wealth), causes to be wasted

23915.meaning1: to throw off; to shake free (of)

examples.text: brahmakāyikānaṃ, bhikkhave, devānaṃ kappo āyuppamāṇaṃ. tattha puthujjano yāvat'āyukaṃ ṭhatvā yāvatakaṃ tesaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ sabbaṃ khepetvā nirayam'pi gacchati tiracchānayonim'pi gacchati pettivisayam'pi gacchati.

23917.meaning1: having ended; having eliminated; having eradicated; having wiped out

examples.text: yo ca tuṭṭhena cittena, suṇāti jinasāsanaṃ, khepetvā āsave sabbe, sacchikatvā akuppataṃ, pappuyya paramaṃ santiṃ, parinibbāti'nāsavo'ti.
khepetvā jātisaṃsāraṃ, pariññāya punabbhavaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchātā, upasantā carissatī'ti.

23920.meaning1: well; safe; secure; at peace; at rest

examples.text: susukhaṃ vata nibbānaṃ, sammāsambuddhadesitaṃ, asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, yattha dukkhaṃ nirujjhatī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so passeyya mahantaṃ udak'aṇṇavaṃ, orimaṃ tīraṃ sāsaṅkaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ, pārimaṃ tīraṃ khemaṃ appaṭibhayaṃ.

23921.meaning1: safety; security; sanctuary; peace; rest; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: anejassa vijānato, n'atthi kāci nisaṅkhati, virato so viyārabbhā, khemaṃ passati sabbadhi.
sabbaṃ lokaṃ abhiññāya, sambuddhena pajānatā, vivaṭaṃ amatadvāraṃ, khemaṃ nibbānapattiyā.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho khemo devaputto bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi

23923.meaning1: name of a park in Bandhumatī

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, khaṇḍo ca rājaputto tisso ca purohitaputto bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā niyyiṃsu. yena khemo migadāyo tena pāyiṃsu.

23924.meaning1: name of the reigning king at the time of Kakusandha Buddha
23924.meaning2: name of the reigning king at the time of Kakusandha Buddha

examples.text: visākhā nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena khemo nāma rājā ahosi. khemassa rañño khemavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghosit'ārāme. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā khemako badarik'ārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.

23928.meaning1: leading to safety; going to security

examples.text: khemañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi khemagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

23929.meaning1: who makes safety; who creates sanctuary

examples.text: nisabhassa appameyyassa, gambhīrassa monapattassa, khemaṅ'karassa vedassa, dhammaṭṭhassa saṃvut'attassa, saṅgātigassa muttassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa khemaṅ'karo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi agg'upaṭṭhāko.

23931.meaning1: place of safety; secure place; sheltered location; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: vantā mah'esīhi kāmā, ye dibbā ye ca mānusā, khemaṭṭhāne vimuttā te, pattā te acalaṃ sukhaṃ.
khemaṭṭhitā janapadā akaṇṭakā anuppīḷā manussā mudā modamānā ure putte naccentā apārutagharā maññe viharanti.

so taṃ purisaṃ tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañ'ca subhikkhatañ'ca app'ābādhatañ'ca puccheyya, tassa so puriso tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañ'ca subhikkhatañ'ca app'ābādhatañ'ca saṃseyya.

23935.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of khema
23935.meaning1: as safety; as peace; as rest; as sanctuary

examples.text: sabbe made abhibho'smi, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, tassa me ahu ussāho, nibbānaṃ abhipassato.
kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.
evaṃ virattaṃ khem'attaṃ, sabbasaṃyojan'ātigaṃ, anvesaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu, mārasenā'pi n'ājjhagā'ti.

23938.meaning1: who sees safety; who sees sanctuary
23938.commentary: (NIDD1) khemadassino'ti khemadassino tāṇadassino leṇadassino saraṇadassino abhayadassino accutadassino amatadassino nibbānadassino'ti, tasmā munayo pariggahaṃ hitvā acariṃsu khemadassino.

examples.text: sokapparidevamaccharaṃ, na jahanti giddhā mamāyite, tasmā munayo pariggahaṃ, hitvā acariṃsu khemadassino.
seyyathā'pi… āṇaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanāmokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khem'antabhūmiṃ

23940.meaning1: place of rest; safe place; peaceful land; sanctuary

examples.text: seyyathā'pi… āṇaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanāmokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khem'antabhūmiṃ
etam'ahaṃ, sāriputta, nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.

23944.commentary: (DNa) abhayaṃ tadā nāgarājānam'āsi, supaṇṇato khemam'akāsi buddho'ti tasmā sabbe'pi te aññam'aññaṃ saṇhāhi vācāhi upavhayantā mittā viya bandhavā viya ca samullapantā sammodamānā āliṅgantā hatthe gaṇhantā aṃsakūṭe hatthaṃ ṭhapentā haṭṭhatuṭṭhacittā.

examples.text: abhayaṃ tadā nāgarājānam'āsi, supaṇṇato khemam'akāsi buddho, saṇhāhi vācāhi upavhayantā, nāgā supaṇṇā saraṇam'akaṃsu buddhaṃ.

23949.meaning1: name of the royal capital of king Khema
23949.meaning2: name of the royal capital of king Khema

examples.text: tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena khemo nāma rājā ahosi. khemassa rañño khemavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
khemātherī anurādho, sāriputto'ti koṭṭhiko, moggallāno ca vaccho ca, kutūhalasālānando, sabhiyo ekādasaman'ti.

23952.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: ketumbharāgo ca mātaṅgo ariyo, ath'accuto accutagāmabyāmako, sumaṅgalo dabbilo supatiṭṭhito, asayho khem'ābhirato ca sorato.

23954.commentary: (MNa) khemiy'ambavane'ti evaṃnāmake ambavane. (MNt) khemiyā nāma rañño deviyā ropitattā taṃ ambavanaṃ khemiy'ambavanan'ti vuccatī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā udeno bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati khemiy'ambavane. tena kho pana samayena ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo bārāṇasiṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

23955.meaning1: name of a group of deities
23955.meaning2: name of a group of deities
23955.commentary: (DNa) khemiyā tusitā yāmā'ti khemiyā devā tusitapuravāsino ca yāmādevalokavāsino ca.

examples.text: khemiyā tusitā yāmā, kaṭṭhakā ca yasassino, lambītakā lāmaseṭṭhā, jotināmā ca āsavā, nimmānaratino āguṃ, ath'āguṃ paranimmitā.

23956.commentary: (KPa) khemino'ti khemavanto, abhayā nirupaddavāti vuttaṃ hoti. (JAa) khemī'ti khemappatto.

examples.text: na tena paṇḍito hoti, yāvatā bahu bhāsati, khemī averī abhayo, paṇḍito'ti pavuccati.
na ca khuddam'ācare kiñci, yena viññū pare upavadeyyuṃ, sukhino'va khemino hontu, sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhit'attā.
balavā puriso jivh'agge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saṃyūhitvā appakasirena vameyya
yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā āpodhātu.

seyyathā'pi, rāhula, pathaviyā sucim'pi nikkhipanti, asucim'pi nikkhipanti, gūthagatam'pi nikkhipanti, muttagatam'pi nikkhipanti, kheḷagatam'pi nikkhipanti, pubbagatam'pi nikkhipanti, lohitagatam'pi nikkhipanti, na ca tena pathavī aṭṭīyati vā harāyati vā jigucchati vā.

23960.meaning1: ball of spit; lump of mucous

examples.text: balavā puriso jivh'agge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saṃyūhitvā appakasirena vameyya
anelagalāyā'ti elagaḷenavirahitāya. yassa kassaci hi kathentassa elā gaḷanti, lālā vā paggharanti, kheḷaphusitāni vā nikkhamanti, tassa vācā elagaḷaṃ nāma hoti, tabbiparitāyā'ti attho.
na harite agilāno uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

23965.meaning2: who eats spittle; who eats or uses what ought to be rejected

23966.synonym: addhā, api, āma, ekantena, kāmaṃ, khu, taggha, nāma, nissaṃsayaṃ, nissaṃsayena, nuna, nūna, byā, vata, ve, sudaṃ, ssa, ha, have, hi

examples.text: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, bhikkhavo'ti. bhadante'ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca

23967.meaning1: and now; but; and next; indeed

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana anāgataṃ rūpaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ, anāgatam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evaṃ rūpena khajjeyyaṃ.
siyā kho pan'ānanda, tumhākaṃ evam'assa, atītasatthukaṃ pāvacanaṃ, n'atthi no satthā'ti.

23970.meaning2: agitating; disturbing; stirring up; shaking up

examples.text: pāmojjaṃ jāyatī'ti tuṭṭhākāro jāyati. pamuditassa pīti jāyatī'ti tuṭṭhassa sakalasarīraṃ khobhayamānā pīti jāyati. pītimanassa kāyo passambhatī'ti pītisampayuttacittassa puggalassa nāmakāyo passambhati, vigatadaratho hoti.

23971.meaning1: agitates; disturbs; stirs up; shakes up
23971.synonym: ghaṭṭeti, cāleti, pavedheti, byāthayati, matheti, loḷeti

examples.text: tassa evam'assa, idaṃ kho parittaṃ gopade udakaṃ. sac'āhaṃ añjalinā vā pivissāmi bhājanena vā khobhessāmi'pi taṃ loḷessāmi'pi taṃ apeyyam'pi taṃ karissāmi.

23972.notes: six types of robe-cloth 1. khoma, 2. kappāsika, 3. koseyya, 4. kambala, 5. sāṇa, 6. bhaṅga

examples.text: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataran'ti khomaṃ, kappāsikaṃ, koseyyaṃ, kambalaṃ, sāṇaṃ, bhaṅgan'ti imesaṃ channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ.
suttaṃ nāma cha suttāni, khomaṃ kappāsikaṃ koseyyaṃ kambalaṃ sāṇaṃ bhaṅgaṃ.
te yena aññataraṃ gāmapaṭṭaṃ ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu. tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ khomaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ
dātā ca ahosi sukhumānaṃ mudukānaṃ attharaṇānaṃ pāvuraṇānaṃ khomasukhumānaṃ kappāsikasukhumānaṃ koseyyasukhumānaṃ kambalasukhumānaṃ

te yena aññataraṃ gāmapaṭṭaṃ ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu. tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ khomaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā… pahūtaṃ khomasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā… pahūtaṃ khomadussaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā… pahūtaṃ kappāsaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā… pahūtaṃ kappāsikasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ

23975.meaning2: name of a village in the Sākyan territory

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati khomadussaṃ nāmaṃ sakyānaṃ nigamo. atha kho bhagavā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya khomadussaṃ nigamaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
evaṃ vutte, khomadussakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītivatthakoṭisahassāni ahesuṃ khomasukhumāni koseyyasukhumāni kambalasukhumāni kappāsikasukhumāni.
te yena aññataraṃ gāmapaṭṭaṃ ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu. tattha addasaṃsu pahūtaṃ khomaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ, disvā… pahūtaṃ khomasuttaṃ chaḍḍitaṃ
cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā ālasy'ānuyoge.

23981.meaning1: I am definitely; I am truly

examples.text: akkhato kho'mhi, tāta kumma, anupahato, atthi ca me idaṃ suttakaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhan'ti.
assutavā kho puthujjano attanā jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃ'y'eva atisitvā, aham'pi kho'mhi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto.
atītam'pi kho [khosaddo sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu n'atthi], bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova īdisesu ṭhānesu pāṭhanānattaṃ n'atthi sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu.

23983.meaning1: you are indeed; you are truly

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakass'eva paccāropeti, tvaṃ kho'si itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohī'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kesiṃ assadammasārathiṃ bhagavā etadavoca, tvaṃ kho'si, kesi, paññāto assadammasārathī'ti. kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, kesi, assadammaṃ vinesī'ti?

23984.meaning1: I am certainly; I am truly

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, ahaṃ kho'smi dāyako dānapati dānassa vaṇṇavādī. dānaṃ dassāmā'ti vadante kin'ti vadeyyan'ti?

api nu tumhe, bhikkhave, evaṃ jānantā evaṃ passantā eta'r'ahi vā paccuppannam'addhānaṃ ajjhattaṃ kathaṃkathī assatha, ahaṃ nu kho'smi, no nu kho'smi, kiṃ nu kho'smi, kathaṃ nu kho'smi, ayaṃ nu kho satto kuto āgato, so kuhiṃgāmī bhavissatī'ti?
kacci nu kho'haṃ suññ'āgāre abhiramāmī'ti, pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
no ca khv'assa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti, ettakaṃ vata me ajja vāsijaṭassa khīṇaṃ, ettakaṃ hiyyo, ettakaṃ pare'ti. atha khv'assa khīṇe khīṇan'tv'eva ñāṇaṃ hoti.

no ca khv'assa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti, ettakā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā'ti. atha khv'assa evam'ettha hoti, ye kho keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā, sabbe te iminā dvārena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pathaviyā lekhā khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati. so ca khv'assa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.

23989.meaning1: indeed it would be; truly it would be

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahako āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca, sādhu khv'assa, bhante thera, sītako ca vāto vāyeyya, abbhasampilāpo ca assa, devo ca ekam'ekaṃ phusāyeyyā'ti.
dvayanissito khv'āyaṃ, kaccāna, loko yebhuyyena, atthitañ'c'eva n'atthitañ'ca.
atha kho uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā etadahosi, ko nu khv'āyaṃ manusso vā amanusso vā gāthaṃ bhāsatī'ti?

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha ussukkaṃ āpanno hoti, atha khv'āssa tibb'āpekkhā hoti adhisīlasikkhāya adhicittasikkhāya adhipaññāsikkhāya.
takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ. yassa ca khv'āssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti.
kiṃ pan'imassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇh'upādinnassa ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā? atha khv'āssa no't'ev'ettha hoti.

evam'evaṃ khv'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, y'āssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā na s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā, yā ca khv'āssa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā.

na khv'āvuso koṭṭhika, sayaṃkataṃ nāmarūpaṃ, na paraṃkataṃ nāmarūpaṃ, na sayaṃkatañ'ca paraṃkatañ'ca nāmarūpaṃ, n'āpi asayaṃkāraṃ aparaṃkāraṃ adhiccasamuppannaṃ nāmarūpaṃ. api ca, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpan'ti.
yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno
satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti.

23995.commentary: (VINa) atha khv'etan'ti atha kho etaṃ. atha kho tan'ti'pi pāṭho. (UDa) na khv'etan'ti na kho etaṃ, ayam'eva vā pāṭho. na khotan'ti'pi paṭhan'ti, na kho etaṃ icc'eva padavibhāgo.

examples.text: atha khv'etaṃ, moghapurisa, appasannānañ'c'eva appasādāya, pasannānañ'ca ekaccānaṃ aññathattāyā'ti.
na khv'etaṃ, bhikkhave, tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe evarūpiṃ kathaṃ katheyyātha.
atthi khv'esa, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya, jegucchī samaṇo gotamo'ti.

23997.meaning1: who goes; goes after; going; gone; having gone; being

examples.text: obhāsajātaṃ phalagaṃ, cittaṃ yassa abhiṇhaso, tādisaṃ bhikkhum'āsajja, kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasī'ti.
evaṃ mano chassu yadā subhāvito, phuṭṭhassa cittaṃ na vikampate kvaci, te rāgadose abhibhuyya bhikkhavo, bhavattha jātimaraṇassa pāragā'ti.
(ga) katamo eko dhammo pariññeyyo? phasso sāsavo upādāniyo. ayaṃ eko dhammo pariññeyyo.

23999.commentary: (THa) gaganā'v'abbha chāditā'ti tato eva saradassa gagana-abbhā viya kāḷameghasañchāditā, nīlavaṇṇā'ti attho.

examples.text: umāpupphena samānā, gaganā'v'abbhachāditā, nānādijagaṇ'ākiṇṇā, te selā ramayanti maṃ.
ratt'ambara-pītavasasāhi, agaru-piyaṅgu-candan'ussadāhi, kañcanatanusannibhattacāhi, paripūraṃ gaganaṃ'va tārakāhi.
